reviewer.evidence:
All 12 family/shared slices were independently read for meaning, register, script, technical terms, and unintended English prose. An AST-based source review confirmed full key coverage, default-key order within every slice, placeholder multisets, and the locale’s CLDR plural-category set. The scaffold report was also used for untranslated-entry discovery and syntax parsing. No tests, builds, typechecks, or gates were run. Corrections: Corrected chart-summary spacing and localized “of” in chart point announcements; changed the Home keyboard key label from the unrelated Thai word for “house”. Kept Jupyter’s literal In [n] markers and clarified the node palette label. Terminology uncertainties: “Embedding”, “span”, “vector”, and graph-hop terminology are specialist AI/graph terms; a Thai technical glossary may prefer other established renderings. Not claimed; this is an AI-assisted independent semantic review. Allowlist has 67 message paths with per-path rationales. Native-speaker certification is not claimed.
